results.check: A1 [THE DERIVATIVE] f'(X) = mu_2(sqrt X) = u(2+u)/(1+u)^2 (sympy)

A2 [THE IDENTITY] T_{mu nu} from the k-essence action equals the
      perfect-fluid form with u^mu = J^mu/n (sympy, explicit metric)
B2 [PHASE 3 -- STIFF] w -> +1 as u -> infinity (high acceleration)

B3 [PHASE 2 -- THE MOND CORRECTION] w = -1 + 4 X^{3/2} + O(X^2):
      the departure of w from -1 is NON-ANALYTIC (X^{3/2})

B4 [MONOTONE] w rises monotonically from -1 to +1 across the branch
      (no phantom crossing, w >= -1 everywhere)

C1 [FLUID = FIELD] c_s^2 = dp/d rho = (u^2+3u+2)/(u^2+3u+4): the
      THERMODYNAMIC sound speed equals the field-theory one

D1 [BAROTROPIC] rho(u) is strictly monotone, so p is a single-valued
      function of rho: p = p(rho) with no independent entropy

E1 [THE CALIBRATION] rho_Lambda recovered from a_0 = c sqrt(G rho_L)/2:
      rho_Lambda = 4 a_0^2/(G c^2)  (=> Lambda^4 = 32 pi M_P^2 a_0^2
      in natural units)

F1 [NOT SELF-GRAVITATING] hydrostatic equilibrium dp/dr = -rho g does
      NOT hold for the r^-2 profile: the ratio |dp/dr| / |rho g| is not 1
